sentences.en: They began to manufacture the machine on a large scale.
sentences.zh: 他们开始大规模生产这种机器。

sentences.en: We had hopes of developing tourism on a big scale.
sentences.zh: 我们希望大规模发展旅游业。

sentences.en: Quality of life was measured using a 5-point Likert scale.
sentences.zh: 生活质量是通过五级李克特量表衡量的。
